requirements.quote:
If a system does not receive successive KEEPALIVE, UPDATE, and/or
   NOTIFICATION messages within the period specified in the Hold Time
   field of the OPEN message, then the NOTIFICATION message with the
   Hold Timer Expired Error Code is sent and the BGP connection is
   closed.
requirements.condition: A system does not receive successive KEEPALIVE, UPDATE, and/or NOTIFICATION messages within the period specified in the Hold Time field of the OPEN message.
requirements.required_behavior: Send a NOTIFICATION message with the Hold Timer Expired Error Code.
requirements.error_behavior: Send a NOTIFICATION message with the Hold Timer Expired Error Code.
requirements.why_checkable: The Hold Timer expiration handler and emitted NOTIFICATION error code can be inspected and checked.
